title: A refused form keeps what was typed
assertion: Text, a select, a text area, a checkbox, a checkbox group, a radio, a date and a month keep the person's values after a refusal, and a valid default never replaces a refused value; a password and a one-time code are emptied, and a note under each says so; the action's state carries no value the person typed; a dropped connection keeps every value and says the save is not confirmed; a page whose CSRF token or request key is out of date is read again in place, and a second press saves with the values intact
noFileReason: The forms are refused in a browser harness with in-memory actions, and on synthetic sign-ins and practices the seed creates; no file.
